content: Yura ari iron kakom Yesu yai ta okom gerai dongua bei kan i tome
Ena kipin ta Yesu fu Yuriari ka nuwi si ereinga ikinom ikai fungoro te yai ta okom gerai dongua ama moime.
Yokamai ama ikai moire “Yesu Yura ari iron kakom yai bei kan i towangua ka kori di towapune,” dire moime. Ena yokamai Yesu toren kaningoro
Yesu yai ta okom gerai dongua “Yae, ne ari yokamai okonom muromdi tei arere moro!” di tere

ena awa tero ari yokamai muruwo mina wakoro di erome. “Iron kakom i kokonan nokapu benapunbo kokonan niki dongua benapunga fanambore faikename? Te iron kakom i ari bei kan i erowapunbore ari ei gorapune” di eromba yokamai giranom kum sire ka mokom di tekeime.

Ena iran Yesu dem miriyom niki de fire ekan koro koro domba yokamai nomanenom du fai erongua iran Yesu kanom ama fi erome. Ena Yesu awa tere yai okom gerai dongua “Ne okonum sino to!” di tongoro yaromi okom sino tongoro okom tokoi nokapu fume.
Ena ari Feresi yokamai u mena fure Eroti ariyoma gere “Yesu si gorapune,” dire ka di koi eime.
Ari yokamai munmane Yesu mouwomdi fime
Ena Yesu gama yokama endiro fu nuwi dian fimba Gariri ari munmane Yesu mouwomdi fime.

Te yokamai iwo ta kimie. Yuria ari te Irumia ari te Yerusarem ari te ari Yoran nuwi bunam koro kei fainga yokamai te ari Taiya te Sairon bunamdi koro kei fainga yokamai Yesu tai benguai gunom fire kumo kamo sire Yesu moingui tei wime.
Yokamai munmane ure Yesu a sin boi moingoro Yesu gama yokama epe di erome. “Nuwi kopare ta ire mari tei deiyo!” di erome,
Te Yesu ari munmane bei kan i erongua iran ari nupi fainga numon deinga yokamai yaromi mapomdi fure “Gam akonapune,” dire irauro keime.
Te ari murom niki dongua ikai koi moi erongua yokamai Yesu kanere ako mangi sire gome dere u oriwom boire “Ne Yai Gumam wam moine,” di moimba
“Na kanam wayom beire di mari dekenaime,” diro Yesu “Nemane,” di erowai te erome.
Yesu ari yokamai okonom koro koro muruwo kaunom surai gunom boime
Ena Yesu kopu ta moko furo tei moire ari nomanem fire mun fi erongua yokamai unom boingoro yokamai moingui tei wime.

Yokamai wingoro yaromi ari okonom koro koro muruwo kaunom surai gunom boire “Ne yokamai na ewi deka finga yokamai moimie,” di erome. Yokamai yaromi gere fana gairo wanaro beinga te yaromi yokamai ewi dowangoro fure ka di mari dowaro beinga
te yaromi yoporam boingua erowangoro yokamai murom niki deinga yokamai ewi mena dowaro beinga Yesu yokamai gunum boime.
Ena ari okonom koro koro muruwo te kaunom surai Yesu gunom boingua yokamai kanom i epe: yai Saimon. Te Saimon yaromi Yesu kam koi engua i Pita dume.
Te Sepeti wam Yemesi te emerom Yoane. Yai surai i Yesu kam koi engua i Boanesi dume. Boanesi mapunom i epe: Kamun nunu dunguamere epe yai surai ka ori dume.
Te yai Enduru te yai Firipi te yai Bataromu te yai Matiyu, te yai Tomasi, te Afia wam Yemesi dom, te yai Tatia, te yai Saimon dom yaromi bai taki sungua yaromi moime.
Te yai ta Yurasi Isakarioti yaromi okome Yesu kiama i mari de erowame.
Ari “Murom niki dongua Bisepu yaromi Yesu dem miriyom ikai koi moime,” dime
Ena Yesu nenen ikomdi ikai fungoro ena ari munmane kumo siro furo kuku boingoro ena Yesu te gama yokamai kua kopuna nowainga kakom dikengoro nekeime.
Ena Yesu ariyoma gunom fire “Yaromi inokore unanan engua nonon kiapam morapune,” dire Yesu moingui tei wime.

Ena te Yura ari ka di guwo dungua nuwi si ereinga yokamai Yerusarem ma dero Yesu moingui tei ure “Murom niki dongua yaromi kam i Bisepu uro Yesu dem miriyom ikai koi moiro akire di tongua yaromi murom niki deinga yokamai ewi mena dome,” epe dime.
Ena iran Yesu ari yokamai unom boingoro wingoro ka eke dere epe di erome. “Satan yaromi tora beiro nenen gama ewi mena dowame?
Te ikinom birom ori ta ari yokama nenen koro koro foi sire kura borainga iki birom ori i wau ename.
Te ari iki ta nenen koro koro foi sire kura borainga iki i gouname.
Ena iran Satan sumuna te gama koro koro foi siro kura borainga yokamai gounaime. Te Satan yaromi gama yokamai ikinom akainom i ama wau ename.

Te nenta fu yai erowai tongua yaromi ikom ikai fure guwai gaiyom kunei nowangua faikenamba koma yaromi fu yai erowai tongua yaromi okom kauwom kan koiro ena okome guwai gaiyom kunei nowangua i faname.
Ena na kawom di erowaika fiyo! Tai niki dongua mapunom mapunom i bianom Yai Gumam kore dowangua faime. Te Yai Gumam kam ka suwainga i bianom ama kore dowangua faimba
nenta Yai Gumam Murom kam ka suwangua i bianom Yai Gumam kore dekename. Bianom fainguai kakom kakom yo duwame,” Yesu epe dume.
Te ari yokamai “Yaromi murom niki dongua ikai koi moi tomie,” dinga iran Yesu ka i epe dume.
Yesu mam te emeroma yokamai kam dume
Ena Yesu ka epe di goungoro mam te emeroma yokamai u iki tei ure mena tei arire moiro yai ta “Yesu uwom boro!” di tere awi Yesu moingui tei deingoro fume.
Te ari Yesu wanapo de suna deinga yokamai “Yae, ne manum te emenuma yokamai mena moiro ne wandou fime,” di teingoro
Ena Yesu “Ari yokamai tora beire na manam bo te na emenama yokamai moingamere epe moraime?” diro mina wako erere
ena ari wanapo deinga yokamai kan koro koro dere “Ne yokamai moingamere na manam bo te emenama epe moimie.
Ari yokamai Yai Gumam kam gore dinga yokamai na manam bo te emenama bo te kepenama yokamai moingamere epe moime,” Yesu epe di erome.
